extractor_notes: 'SERVICE: free-to-air' names a delivery type, not a channel, and 'TRANSMISSION: not stated' gives no date or time. Following the instruction that a decision is about a transmission, I have recorded one transmission with the service as given and date and start_time as not_stated; the missing date and time, and the possibility of a timeshift service, are both carried in not_stated. o1: the source says explicitly that no sexual activity is shown, so is_depicted is false and treatment is 'reported_not_shown'. I have not recorded a strong_language observation for this event: the source says the acts are described 'in explicit terms' but does not quote any word or say that expletives are used, so whether this is also a language matter cannot be established from the text; the gap is listed in not_stated. o2: I have categorised a bare male chest as 'nudity' because that is the nearest controlled-vocabulary value for uncovered body, but the source says only that the chest is bare and nothing about any other part of the body, so the confidence is medium and a reviewer may consider a bare chest outside the intended sense of the category. o3: the chest-waxing event, taken as the infliction of pain on a person played for comedy, fits none of the listed categories cleanly. It is not plainly violence (no assault, weapon or attack is described), not fear_distress (the framing is comic), and not imitable_behaviour on the text given (no instruction or technique detail is stated). As instructed, I have used 'offence_general' and flagged it here. o2 and o3 are a deliberate split of the single 00:21:15 entry: the bare chest and the depiction of pain are separate facts that may attract separate rules. treatment is 'comedic' for both, on the source's own words 'Played entirely for comedy'; for o1 the comic framing is stated too ('Sustained comic dialogue') but treatment carries 'reported_not_shown' instead, since the field can hold only one value and whether the event is shown is the more consequential distinction under the extraction rules. That the 00:09:30 event is comic is preserved in what_happens and descriptors. 'CERTIFICATE: BBFC 15' gives no scope, so scope is not_stated. is_news_or_current_affairs is set to 'no' on the basis of the stated descriptor 'comedy feature'. is_made_primarily_for_children is left not_stated because the description says nothing about intended audience.
